name: Galio Sundae Patisserie
summary: A single bakery dressed as a pastry parlour in one colour family: every ground, band and plate is a tint of the chosen palette's hue (cherry by default), with white pages taking turns with tinted bands, Shrikhand over Outfit with Caveat script kickers; a side rail in the family's near-black with a scalloped awning edge (a top bar and menu sheet on phones), a hero slider of the best-selling collections, line-drawn collections, a mosaic of the real ways to get an order, a price list with dot leaders, best sellers on round plates with tilted stickers in the brand colour, the real counter on a map and the journal. Light by default, with a dark mode in the same family and a footer Theme row; switching the palette re-tints the whole page.
